_note: Facts published after the 30-Sep-2026 as-of date. Kept out of the initiation (PLAYBOOK §1); recorded for the first update.

facts.fact: Q2FY27 results: revenue Rs969 cr (+24% YoY), PAT Rs73 cr; Screener: EBITDA Rs173 cr (18% margin), depreciation Rs55 cr, tax ~0%.

Balance sheet at 30-Sep-2026 (Screener): intangible assets Rs3,054 cr (Rs1,581 cr at Mar-26) and CWIP Rs676 cr (Rs2,379 cr): the Zaynich intangible appears to have been capitalised in H1FY27; borrowings Rs2,238 cr.
CRISIL monitoring agency report for the quarter to 30-Sep-2026: no deviation; Rs893.32 cr of the Rs1,000 cr QIP used.
Sumit Garg (Chief Digital & Information Officer) designated senior management.
Independent director Vinesh Kumar Jairath ceased after completing his second five-year term.
Sep-2026 shareholding pattern (filed in October): promoters 49.33%, FIIs 7.02%, DIIs 9.00%, public 34.64%, 173,116 shareholders.
